```plato

    // The standard rounded-box inside test: fold the query into the first quadrant,
    // subtract the inner (unrounded) half-extents, and compare the resulting
    // distance to the corner radius. Boundary inclusive.
    // https://iquilezles.org/articles/distfunctions2d/
    Contains(r: RoundedRect2D, point: Point2D): Boolean
    {
        var radius = r.EffectiveCornerRadius;
        var qx = (point.X - r.Rect.Center.X).Abs - (r.Rect.Size.Width * 0.5 - radius);
        var qy = (point.Y - r.Rect.Center.Y).Abs - (r.Rect.Size.Height * 0.5 - radius);
        var outside = (qx.Max(0.0).Square + qy.Max(0.0).Square).Sqrt;
        return outside + qx.Max(qy).Min(0.0) <= radius;
    }
```

```plato
    // True when the query, expressed in the box's own frame, lies within the
    // half-extents on both axes. Boundary inclusive.
    Contains(b: OrientedBox2D, point: Point2D): Boolean
    {
        var q = LocalOffset(b.Center, b.Rotation, point);
        return q.X.Abs <= b.Size.Width * 0.5 && q.Y.Abs <= b.Size.Height * 0.5;
    }
```

```plato
    // True when the point is within Radius of the centre. Boundary inclusive;
    // compares squared distances so no square root is taken.
    Contains(c: Circle, point: Point2D): Boolean
        => c.Center.Between(point).MagnitudeSquared <= c.Radius.Square;
```

```plato

    // True when the point's distance from the centre lies in [InnerRadius,
    // OuterRadius]. Both boundaries inclusive.
    Contains(a: Annulus, point: Point2D): Boolean
    {
        var distanceSquared = a.Center.Between(point).MagnitudeSquared;
        return distanceSquared >= a.InnerRadius.Square
            && distanceSquared <= a.OuterRadius.Square;
    }
```

## Line 314

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/planar.library.plato, line 314](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/planar.library.plato#L314).

```plato

    // True when the point is within the radius AND its bearing from the centre,
    // measured forward from Sweep.Start, is within the swept angle. The bearing is
    // wrapped into [0, 1) turns before the comparison, so the test is correct
    // across the +X seam.
    Contains(s: CircularSector, point: Point2D): Boolean
    {
        var v = s.Circle.Center.Between(point);
        var offset = (v.Y.Atan2(v.X) - s.Sweep.Start).Turns;
        var wrapped = offset - offset.Floor;
        return v.MagnitudeSquared <= s.Circle.Radius.Square
            && wrapped <= s.Sweep.Extent.Turns;
    }
```

```plato

    // True when the point lies in the disk AND on the arc's side of the chord. For
    // a forward (counter-clockwise) sweep the arc side is the CLOCKWISE side of the
    // directed chord ChordStart -> ChordEnd, so the orientation test is <= 0; that
    // holds for both minor (theta < pi) and major (theta > pi) segments.
    Contains(s: CircularSegment, point: Point2D): Boolean
        => s.Circle.Contains(point)
        && TwiceSignedArea(s.ChordStart, s.ChordEnd, point) <= 0.0;
```

```plato
    // True when (x/a)^2 + (y/b)^2 <= 1 in the ellipse's own frame. Boundary
    // inclusive.
    Contains(e: Ellipse, point: Point2D): Boolean
    {
        var q = LocalOffset(e.Center, e.Rotation, point);
        return (q.X / e.SemiAxes.X).Square + (q.Y / e.SemiAxes.Y).Square <= 1.0;
    }
```

```plato

    // True when |x/a|^n + |y/b|^n <= 1 in the superellipse's own frame — the
    // defining Lame inequality. Boundary inclusive.
    Contains(se: SuperEllipse, point: Point2D): Boolean
    {
        var q = LocalOffset(se.Center, se.Rotation, point);
        return (q.X / se.SemiAxes.X).Abs.Pow(se.Exponent)
            + (q.Y / se.SemiAxes.Y).Abs.Pow(se.Exponent) <= 1.0;
    }
```

```plato
    // True when `point` lies in the closed triangle: the three edge orientation
    // tests agree in sign (a zero means the point is on that edge's line, so the
    // boundary is included). Winding-agnostic — it accepts either orientation.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Point_in_polygon
    Contains(t: Triangle2D, point: Point2D): Boolean
    {
        var ab = TwiceSignedArea(t.A, t.B, point);
        var bc = TwiceSignedArea(t.B, t.C, point);
        var ca = TwiceSignedArea(t.C, t.A, point);
        var anyNegative = ab < 0.0 || bc < 0.0 || ca < 0.0;
        var anyPositive = ab > 0.0 || bc > 0.0 || ca > 0.0;
        return (anyNegative && anyPositive).Not;
    }
```

## Line 841

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/planar.library.plato, line 841](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/planar.library.plato#L841).

```plato

    // True when `point` solves (point - Origin) = u*SideA + v*SideB with both u and
    // v in [0, 1]. Solved by Cramer's rule on the 2x2 side matrix; boundary
    // inclusive. Undefined (division by zero) for the degenerate parallel-sides
    // case the declaration excludes. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cramer%27s_rule
    Contains(g: Parallelogram2D, point: Point2D): Boolean
    {
        var w = g.Origin.Between(point);
        var determinant = g.SideA.X * g.SideB.Y - g.SideA.Y * g.SideB.X;
        var u = (w.X * g.SideB.Y - w.Y * g.SideB.X) / determinant;
        var v = (g.SideA.X * w.Y - g.SideA.Y * w.X) / determinant;
        return u >= 0.0 && u <= 1.0 && v >= 0.0 && v <= 1.0;
    }
```
